facts.fact: Mutare City Council's Town Clerk told a CLGF clinic that residents take part in the council's annual budget consultations through a WhatsApp chatbot and an online consultation platform, with more than 20,000 participants.

ZWE.note: Electronic procurement approvals inside one council's system are stated; no tenders published or bid online.

facts.fact: Mutare City Council ran its annual budget consultations through a WhatsApp chatbot and an online consultation platform, lifting participation from fewer than 300 residents to more than 20,000, as reported by CLGF.

ZWE.note: LADS is an application; no connection of local government offices is stated.

facts.fact: Mutare City Council's LADS, begun in 2019 with a revenue module, gives digital billing and automated debtor management, lifting revenue collection efficiency from 33 per cent in 2019 to an average 65 per cent in 2026, per the Town Clerk as reported by CLGF.
LADS is a locally designed platform run by Mutare City Council, with no national or shared system stated.
Only Mutare City Council is named as using LADS for revenue administration.
